items.title: US war in Iran leaves Sri Lanka in troubled diplomatic waters
Iranians face looming war threat with no reliable info
items.description: Ordinary people living in Iran have little idea of the course of the war and peace talks on the global stage. With few sources of information, they are forced to navigate conflicting rumors and fears of a nuclear attack.

items.title: Death toll rises to 50 in Russian attack on aid distribution ‌point in Ukraine
items.description: The death toll from Russia's bombing of an aid ​distribution ‌point in ⁠Ukraine's southeastern Zaporizhzhia region on Monday ‌has risen to 50, Kyiv's Emergency Service said on Friday, making it ​one of the deadliest strikes ‌on civilians this year.

items.title: Trump Meets Privately With Putin Envoy After White House Event Marking Oleshky Ceasefire
items.description: The U.S. president did not disclose what he discussed with envoy Kirill Dmitriev, but he predicted a deal to end the war in Ukraine could emerge soon.

items.title: UK jailing of Indian sailor over Russia sanctions sets off ‘perfect storm’
items.description: Captain Ajay Pant was in international waters when his allegedly 'shadow' tanker was captured by British soldiers.

items.title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
items.description: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.

items.title: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple
items.description: Attacks that damaged or destroyed water and sanitation systems in conflict zones tripled between 2021 and 2025, increasing children’s risk of exposure to disease outbreaks, malnutrition and violence.

items.title: Following Oleshky Truce, Melania Trump To Host Russia-Ukraine Talks
items.description: US first lady Melania Trump will host Russian and Ukrainian representatives at the White House on November 5 for a meeting following a localized cease-fire in Ukraine's southern Kherson region, as a new round of US-mediated peace talks is set to take place next week.
